brief: The 6-tool no-code stack that runs my $30K/mo business.

slots.title: Webflow For Pages
slots.body: I design and host my entire site on Webflow. No dev needed, and it looks pro out of the box.

slots.title: Notion For Ops
slots.body: Notion runs my entire back office. Docs, SOPs, and content calendars all live in one spot.

slots.title: Airtable Tracks Leads
slots.body: All my data lives in Airtable. It handles my CRM, inventory, and project timelines without SQL.

slots.title: Make Does Heavy Lifting
slots.body: Make moves data between apps while I sleep. Invoices, emails, and updates happen completely hands-free.

slots.title: Stripe Takes Payments
slots.body: Stripe handles every charge and payout. It hooks straight into my site for one-click checkout.

slots.title: ConvertKit Nurtures Leads
slots.body: ConvertKit sends sequences and launches products. My email automations print cash on autopilot daily.

slots.headline: Build Your No-Code Stack
slots.body: Grab these six tools and launch today. You don't need code to scale.
